diagram_math_checks.evidence: The displayed example has beta,gamma in B_3: conjugation has three input/output positions throughout; each stabilization has four. The caption explicitly generalizes positions 3,4 to n,n+1 for n>=1. No sigma_0 or stabilization of the empty braid is drawn or claimed. This matches Definition lines 59-75.

Each stabilization beta box acts only on the first three of four target positions; the fourth vertical strand bypasses the box. The caption identifies these as Q^(4), not unchanged Q^(3) strands. This is the geometric word realization of iota_3:B_3->B_4 in Definition lines 37-54, using the half-twist supports that fix the rightmost target point for old indices.

Upward arrows encode increasing time. Bottom-to-top factors are gamma^(-1), beta, gamma, so the algebraic product is gamma beta gamma^(-1), as required by the rightmost-factor-first convention at lines 84-87. The blocks have three strands and do not assert any internal permutation or unnecessary geometric cancellation.

In def-elementary-geometric-half-twist, rho(1/2)=(0,-h); the left point travels to the right with negative second disk coordinate. With positive second coordinate toward the viewer it is the underpassing diagonal. The positive panel gaps the bottom-left to top-right diagonal; the other diagonal is continuous. Both swap positions 3 and 4 and fix positions 1 and 2.

The opposite half twist reflects the second coordinate and represents the inverse in def-elementary-geometric-half-twist. Accordingly the negative panel gaps the bottom-right to top-left diagonal and leaves bottom-left to top-right continuous, reversing over/under while retaining the same endpoint transposition and fixed first two positions.

In both stabilization panels the new half twist lies below the beta block, hence is traversed first: products are iota_3(beta) sigma_3 and iota_3(beta) sigma_3^(-1). The caption distinguishes reversing the Markov move from reversing strand time. The original arbitrary-factor insertion caveat remains byte-identical; the picture asserts no arbitrary insertion conjugacy.

No closure arcs or isotopy arrows are drawn. Remarks explicitly retain equal-disk-coordinate identification at t=1 and t=0, increasing-time orientation, and the fixed phi/disk framing of def-closure-of-a-geometric-braid (Components and orientation; The standard axis and fixed framing). No isotopy fixing the braid axis or change of framing is asserted.
All original defining formulas and justifications remain byte-for-byte unchanged. The added caption explicitly states their independence from the schematic; the figure supplies no proof premise.
